source.title: Northern Whig, 18 March 1899, p. 7 ("Castleblayney Union": district councillors nominated)
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; no other nomination, no poll

note: First election of the Castleblayney No. 2 rural district council (the Co. Armagh part of Castleblayney union, also called Crossmaglen Rural District), polled 6 April 1899; two councillors for each division. The nomination list also prints "Crossmaglen—James Hale and Patrick M'Shane, sen., P.L.G.", a second entry for Crossmaglen that is probably another division misnamed; it is not filed. Returned unopposed. The only two nominated; no poll is reported.
